title: Divar
summary: Campaign key visuals and an AI mascot, brought together in one distinctive visual world.
challenge: Give different campaigns a recognisable shared language, while making AI features feel approachable.
role: Key visual design, art direction and AI mascot identity.
deliverables: Campaign imagery, a character system and a family of category assets for digital touchpoints.
credits: Design by Ali Komeili. Presentation imagery recreated from the original project references.

blocks.title: The message leads.
blocks.text: The campaign language works beyond the mascot. Furniture, electronics and cars each become a focused scene, while listing cards connect the imagery to the marketplace. Red creates continuity; changes in composition, scale and subject give each message its own rhythm.

blocks.title: A helpful presence.
blocks.text: The AI character introduces a different layer of the visual language. A compact ivory body, two articulated arms and an amber display make it recognisable. Expressions and gestures adapt to promotion, conversation and discovery, within the same red campaign world.

blocks.title: From a visual to an experience.
blocks.text: The visual language moves between a human campaign scene and smaller components for digital touchpoints. Category objects become a coordinated family inside a white application card, presented against the same red background.
